overview: Human Specimens is adapted from the novel by Kanae Minato, one of Japan's most celebrated mystery writers, known for her international bestseller Confessions which was adapted into the acclaimed film that represented Japan at the 83rd Academy Awards. The dark tale follows Professor Shirô Sakaki, a butterfly researcher, who confesses to turning six young boys, including his own son Itaru, into "human specimens."
title: Human Specimens

overview: Azil, raised in the rebellious waters of the Black Sea, is suddenly confronted with all the secrets of his past: he is the lost heir of the Maçari family, one of Turkey's most powerful dynasties. Shaken by the death of the woman he knew as his mother, Azil steps into the dark world of Istanbul in search of the truth. Fate drags him into both a reckoning with his brother and an impossible love that burns his heart. In this world of intrigues and betrayals, Azil's test will be not only with power but also with conscience.
title: Gözleri Karadeniz
Jing Ji Yu Jiu Yue Guang
Dang Mei Li Xiao Shi Hou
Chong Hui Jiu Ling Nian Dai，Chong Qi Wu Du Man Di Jin

overview: Seven short episodes dealing with Ha Ni's and Seung Jo's life after their marriage, released on the official youtube channel ytkiss.
title: Mischievous Kiss: YouTube Edition

overview: Ex-cop's life shatters when kidnappers take his daughter, implant a bomb, and force him on lethal missions. With enigmatic allies, his choices rewrite destinies while unraveling a conspiratorial web.
title: Rescue the Girl

overview: Bound by a promise that spans a thousand years, a valiant female general is transported into the body of Fu Yunyun, a dying heiress. To clear her name and uncover the truth, she uses herself as bait, navigating the cold and calculating husband with careful diplomacy. At the same time, she faces the devoted yet scheming attention of her cunning brother-in-law and the unwavering loyalty of a soldier who followed her through time. Three men vie for Fu Yunyun's heart, each showing their own cunning, while the confident and strong-willed heroine stays true to herself, cutting through layers of deception to finally uncover the truth and her ultimate desire in life.
title: Keeping up with Beauty

overview: The enigmatic transfer student Xun Weilai and the strange new neighbor Zhao Liao disrupt the mundane life of high school student Zhao Zuoyou. Little does he know, these two individuals are actually his future selves! At ages 16, 41, and 66, the three versions of Zhao Zuoyou possess completely different personalities and intentions. Each has their own purpose, and they begin to vie for the singular life they share.
title: The Triple Echo of Time

overview: Big Mistakes follows Nicky and Morgan, two deeply incapable siblings who are in over their heads when a misguided theft for their dying grandmother accidentally pulls them into the world of organized crime. Blackmailed into increasingly dangerous assignments, they clumsily fail upwards, sinking deeper into chaos they're ill-equipped to handle.
title: Big Mistakes

overview: «Stavka na lyubov'» is an extreme reality show where star couples test the strength of their feelings. According to the rules of the project, participants undergo tests and place "bets" on their partners: will they cope or not. Those who guess the outcome of the tests receive immunity, and those who do not guess are nominated by voting. Only one couple will win and receive a cash prize.
title: Ставка на любовь

overview: The project continues the tradition of the "Survivality" universe: the heroes who find themselves in it are tested not only on a wide variety of physical and moral qualities, but also on their intellect, resourcefulness, and cunning. Two teams of celebrities find themselves in an exotic country. Each team includes a lone wolf whose task is to prevent their teammates from winning the challenges and remain undetected until the very end of the episode. Abandoned to their fate in the wild jungle, the heroes survive in a camp they've built themselves and undergo challenges prepared by the host, pitting the teams against each other to discover who the "Snake" is on their team.
title: Выживалити. Змееловы

overview: This gripping docuseries traces the events leading up to the 2019 murder of young Brazilian actor Rafael Miguel and his parents.
title: O Assassinato do Ator Rafael Miguel

overview: Renowned actor and comedian, Adrián Uribe, returns as the iconic public transit driver, "El Vítor," to host this entertaining game show. On "Piensa Rápido," two teams of friends and family compete to see who can guess the most popular answers to general knowledge and pop culture questions the fastest. The key to winning is using quick thinking and wit to figure out what everyone else is thinking before time runs out. In the question rounds, "El Vítor" will give an incomplete phrase, and teams will take turns trying to find the most popular words that complete it. They will have 60 seconds to do so and will get the first letter of each word on the screen as a clue. Each episode consists of three question rounds, following a consistent format to ensure a smooth and exciting flow. At the end of these rounds, the team with the lowest score will be eliminated. The winning team will advance to the final round, where they will have a limited amount of time to correctly identify the main words that complete four phrases. For each correctly completed phrase, they will earn cash prizes and have the chance to win up to $6,000.
title: Piensa Rápido

overview: Diná is the sister of the delinquent and vengeful Alexandre, who, after dying in prison, begins to torment from the spiritual plane those he considers to be his enemies.
title: A Viagem

overview: The story follows two unique board-gaming friends meandering through leafy suburban life, charting a story about Judo, ancient Rome, first loves, and the expansion of the Universe.
title: Leonard and Hungry Paul

overview: Drama series based on the best-selling, real life diaries of an upmarket escort. This programme is a deeper look into the world of the glamorous and intelligent Belle de Jour - Hannah to her family.
title: Secret Diary of a Call Girl
Zhou Jiao Shou, Wo Men Jie Hun Ba

overview: "The World Tomorrow" is a dynamic new television discussion series featuring Julian Assange as host. It is a collection of twelve interviews featuring an eclectic range of guests, who are stamping their mark on the future: politicians, revolutionaries, intellectuals, artists and visionaries.
title: The World Tomorrow

overview: The Noticias Telemundo AHORA newscast, anchored by Damià Bonmatí and Claudia de la Fuente, will air on the Telemundo network at 7 a.m. ET on weekday mornings. The program features the latest headlines, interviews with key newsmakers, weather forecasts from Noticias Telemundo Chief Meteorologist Carlos Robles and on-the-ground reporting from across the country by the team of award-winning correspondents at Noticias Telemundo and Telemundo's local stations.
title: Noticias Telemundo AHORA

overview: Gyu-hyun and Ji-seok run the beloved Prince Barbershop. With their handsome looks and outstanding skills, they've gained quite the following. But when the adorable and charming Eun-seok shows up, a tug-of-war of love begins between the three.
title: Prince Barbershop

overview: When high school teacher Na Aejoon shows up for work on an ordinary day, he never expects to bump into his favorite celebrity in the hallway. But when his school becomes a filming location for a show starring Choi Siyeol, his bias from the idol group A-One, that's exactly what happens! If that's not enough to give a fanboy a heart attack, Siyeol takes an interest in Aejoon and asks him to join the show as his "co-teacher." Desperate to keep his fan life a secret, Aejoon is forced to put his acting skills to the test, and not just on camera. But as he spends more and more time with Siyeol, the deception becomes harder to keep up. Not to mention, he might not be the only one keeping secrets…
title: My bias is Showing!

overview: Follows Han Seun, first year Business Administration student & Yoo Chaemin, Vice President of the Basketball Club!
title: Summertime

overview: Sold by envious brothers, Joseph overcomes adversity to become Egypt's second-in-command. When his brothers reenter his life, he faces his greatest challenge.
title: Joseph of Egypt

overview: "People's Sexiest Man Alive" is an annual event that has been aired on TV since 2010 but has been awarded since the 1st award was presented to Mel Gibson on 4 February 1995.
title: People's Sexiest Man Alive
Meng Li Jiang Shan, Zhang Zhong Feng Hua

overview: After a car accident leads Jin Daxi to be mistaken for his estranged twin brother Tong Sheng, the two switch lives, triggering clashes, unexpected romance, and tests of family loyalty. With the help of Jin Dahuan and Yan Yan, they work together to expose a dangerous scheme.
title: A Lifetime of Happiness

overview: They are not plants, not animals, and not protozoa. And yet they are everywhere. Even inside you! Mushrooms. A magical kingdom, thanks to which life on the planet became what it is. A story about the main and most important discoveries of mycology. How to look for mushroom places. How to cook mushrooms so that they become not only tasty, but also useful. What dangers await an inexperienced mushroom picker in the forest. A mushroom picking trip is a real journey through the mushroom kingdom of Russia.
title: Царство грибов

overview: A news program with everything you need to know before the day ends. The most relevant news from the United States and the world, in 20 minutes.
title: Noticias Telemundo en la noche

overview: Several millennia ago, Yao Ling'er, the Deity of Gourmandise, failed her tribulations in the Arctic Terra. As she was struck by lightning, she accidentally freed the Azure Fox Demon that was sealed away many years ago. The fox demon saved Yao Ling'er from her dangerous situation. To prevent the fox demon from being hunted by her immortal fellows, she brought him back to her abode and nursed it to health. As years gone by, they slowly developed feelings toward one another. One day, the martial senior of Yao Ling'er, Mo Nan, visited her and discovered the loving couple. He devised a plan to drive a wedge between the couple, causing the fox demon to die with resentment. To clear up the misunderstanding, Yao Ling'er turned into a human and descended to the Mortal Realm. There, the fox demon became Xia Xiaoyao, who had nothing but vengeance in his mind following his childhood tragedy that resulted in his broken family. Yao Ling'er helped him investigate the truth. As their journey unfolded, they solved one after another Foxfire incidents. Their misunderstanding cleared up and they once again embraced the feelings they had for each other.
title: The Fox's Chant

overview: Qiao Zhi came from a family with a prestigious culinary legacy — his ancestors had served as imperial chefs in the royal court, and his grandfather had gained nationwide fame through the treasured cookbook Jin Kui Recipes. Unfortunately, his grandfather lost his reputation and cherished family establishment when he was framed by the devious head apprentice and passed away in despair. After this accident, Qiao Zhi, despite holding a university degree, turned down a promising corporate career offered by his professor and chose to honor his grandfather's dying wish. He set out to reclaim the restaurant "Shi Tang" and dedicate his life to preserving and promoting the profound heritage of Chinese culinary arts.
title: Chef Son-in-low

overview: The genius young girl Lin Que's father, known as the "King of Sparrows," was murdered. After growing up, she seeks revenge for her father by deliberately approaching the mysterious tycoon, Ninth Master, intending to use him for her vengeance. Ninth Master is looking for a game prodigy to compete in the Sparrow God Tournament on his behalf. The two start off using each other, but gradually fall in love in the process—until Lin Que mistakenly believes that Ninth Master is the murderer who killed her father, leading them into a love-hate entanglement…
title: Queen Of Cards

overview: Welcome to Lietteville Women's Prison the series follow the daily lives of a small group of women in the same unit, Unit 9.
title: Unité 9

overview: After almost 30 years of silence, a victim shares new and disturbing details of the horror she experienced in the home of the person who became known throughout Brazil as the woman with white ointment on her face.
title: A Mulher da Casa Abandonada

overview: Nack is a lottery-obsessed engineering student dreaming of hitting the jackpot and retiring early. Although he possesses a particular skill for guessing, when it comes to choosing lottery numbers for himself, his luck is laughably bad. With rumours swirling about hot medical student Jafar revealing winning numbers, Nack tracks him down, only to be met with a reality check. But when a dream of Jafar leads Nack to his first-ever lotter win, he dubs Jafar his personal lottery god and starts orbiting him like a disciple, asking to treat him for his win. Although Jafar finds Nack odd, he eventually agrees and finds himself warming to Nack. While Nack secretly mines their time together for lucky numbers, Jafar's friends form a shipper LINE chat to push the clueless duo closer.
title: Lottery Doctor

overview: Clarice, a carefree, budding screenwriter, playfully kisses Téo, an awkward medical student, to annoy her college boyfriend—but the joke turns into a nightmare when Téo, fixated on making Clarice love him, abducts her for a frantic road trip across Rio de Janeiro. As his obsession intensifies, he goes to extreme lengths to safeguard their supposedly perfect life.
title: Dias Perfeitos

overview: After 7 years sober, Charlie Sheen candidly discusses his rise to fame and public downfall, joined by family and friends who share untold stories of his journey through stardom, struggles, and redemption.
title: aka Charlie Sheen

overview: Five singles are about to give up hope and are challenged to rethink dating. But will it work?
title: Singelgåten

overview: In the late 1970s, infamous serial killer the Yorkshire Ripper seemed to be taunting the police with handwritten letters and creepy tape recordings. But in fact, Peter Sutcliffe was operating in the shadows – and the police had been taken in by a very costly hoax. Hunting The Yorkshire Ripper introduces viewers to former Detective Chief Superintendent Chris Gregg, at the time a rookie detective working on the Ripper manhunt. Unable to get the hoaxer's voice out of his head, after rising up through the ranks, Gregg set out to get closure, putting together a cold case team to track down the man who – by diverting police away from the real perpetrator – allowed Sutcliffe to continue killing, leading to an interrogation room showdown decades in the making.
title: Hunting the Yorkshire Ripper

overview: Since their divorce 29 years ago, Jacques and Francine have seen little. They meet again today, while Jacques receives a badge of honor to commemorate his work at the Mémoires Vives Foundation, an organization that assists the relatives of missing persons, whose founders they are. Despite their differences, Jacques and Francine are united by a common tragedy, that of the disappearance of their little daughter Laurie thirty years ago. Jacques's second wife, Claire, also wears a moving secret that will soon burst into the open. For three years, she has lived alone in the family home of Saint-Hilaire where she and Jacques have raised their two daughters. Claire is finally ready to open her heart to a new lover. Bright memories, it is the story of families haunted despite themselves by a still alive past. But whose characters, engaged in an inspiring quest for truth, will find a bliss they no longer expected.
title: Mémoires vives

overview: In Logan, Queensland, The Toolbox Murders begins with the brutal killings of Cory Breton and Iuliana Triscaru. Cory, wrongly suspected of being a police informant, and Iuliana, caught in the wrong place at the wrong time, are lured to a drug den by a gang led by Stou Daniels. What follows is a deadly cocktail of drug-fuelled paranoia and brutality. The victims are violently tortured, locked in a large metal toolbox, and transported on the back of a ute to Scrubby Creek, where they are drowned alive.
title: The Toolbox Murders

overview: Dive into the ultimate gaming neighborhood where streaming superstars compete in an electrifying mash-up of esports, physical challenges, and unexpected insurance-themed mishaps. Each season, a diverse cast of high-profile gamers and content creators face off in live-streamed challenges—ranging from trivia and online gaming to yard-style stunts—with comedic obstacles built into the set to metaphorically reflect the role of insurance in everyday life
title: State Farm Gamerhood Challenge

overview: Iain Stirling's Roast The Internet is all about the very worst things on the internet (that he's legally able to talk about on broadcast television). Every episode, Iain roasts social clips, posts and trends, with three famous faces - comedians, online celebrities and TV personalities - joining him each week to tackle their own online bugbears. And alongside all the roasting, Iain and his guests also offer up some ingenious and hilarious solutions to the dumpster fire that is the online world. With outrageous clips, funny chat and top comedy performances, Iain and his guests take the internet down a peg or two, while all also secretly hoping their best bits will go viral.
title: Iain Stirling's Roast the Internet

overview: A heartbreaking first love story of a man who was destined to be the fate of two women who were bus guides in the 1980s, and a melodrama, growth, human, comedy of shining youths who were destined to be brilliant.
title: A Hundred Memories

overview: While counting the days to become a kindergarten teacher, Dünya's life changes overnight after a tragedy at the construction site where her father works. Under the pressure of merciless businessman Noyan Erim, she finds herself trapped in his mansion. Separated from her family, she struggles to survive behind closed doors amid hostility, obsession, and secret alliances, fighting to protect her loved ones while searching for a path to freedom. Noyan's right hand man Sinan risks everything to shield her from Noyan's escalating cruelty, and an unspoken closeness grows between them. Yet their love is tested by the wounds of the past and the intrigues that haunt the mansion.
title: Aşka Mahkum

overview: You think you know the story, but do you really? Take a deeper look into everybody's favorite movies and TV shows, from I Love Lucy to Jurassic Park!
title: The Unknown Story

overview: From teen years to adulthood, two friends linked by warmth and tension grow apart -- until one is asked to accompany the other through her final days.
title: You and Everything Else

overview: The characters of the film return home after a vacation on Baikal, to their everyday life, during which each of them faces their own problems. Valya returns to St. Petersburg to defend her diploma thesis, Stepa is fired from his job, Bulat, an eternal student, is transferred to a commercial form of education... Each episode is a separate story with its own unique character!
title: На Байкал. Поехали

overview: GMMTV artists take a bonding trip where they compete in challenges and take adventures together.
title: High Season

overview: After a whirlwind of nappies and night feeds, Sam and Billie are rediscovering their passions and reliving their youth.
title: Sam & Billie: Sister Act

overview: Leaded by court marshal Tobias Dybvad, six brave knights are ready for a ridiculous contest for gold, royal crowns and the honorable title of 'The Kingliest King'.
title: Kongens efterfølger

overview: Where in Rus' can you live well, and most importantly, for a long time? The main lover of life and optimist of the Russian scene, Mitya Fomin, goes on a fascinating journey around the country to find out how to live to 100. Eight episodes are eight regions of Russia with high life expectancy and bright heroes aged 80-90-100, who live a full life in different parts of our country, despite their golden age. They participate in competitions, set records, climb rocks, build cars, fall in love and have affairs. A doctor by education and a biohacker by life, Mitya knows exactly how to get the most out of life. But will he be able to give our heroes a head start in physical fitness, sense of humor and attitude to life?!?
title: На все 100!

overview: The story takes place in a secret, state-of-the-art base in Antarctica, where seven strangers were selected by a billionaire tycoon to participate in a program that aims to determine who of them is the most suitable to win a position in the company. However, the candidates' stay begins to get complicated when they disappear one by one under mysterious circumstances, which will test the trust between them, while they are isolated and monitored by a rigorous artificial intelligence system called AGATHA.
title: Nieve roja

overview: Serhat, a highly successful surgeon who traded the destiny his homeland had in store for him for building a completely different life for himself in Istanbul. This decision leads him to Melek, whom Serhat immediately falls in love with and secretly marries without his family knowing, but fate has an unforeseen surprise waiting for him. Forced to return to Urfa, Serhat finds himself in the middle of the past he has been running from for years, living in the shadow of two rival families. Pushed to accept the values he once rejected and transform from a career-driven surgeon to agha, Serhat faces a difficult choice, which is only exacerbated when his family asks that he marry Yıldız to end the feud completely. With Melek's arrival, the balance of power in the mansion is completely upset. As Melek arrives in Serhat's homeland in hopes of reuniting with her love, Serhat is torn between his heart and his conscience, and he must face the weight of his past.
title: Halef: Köklerin Çağrısı

overview: Following the bankruptcy of their restaurant (he was the head chef and the owner), Karine and Patrick find themselves on the street. They have no choice but to return to live "temporarily" with Karine's parents, in the basement of their bungalow, just until they get back on their feet - which could be longer than expected.
title: Boomerang

overview: Short lived sitcom about the goings on at a movie theatre. The show mainly focused on Scott Creasman, who wanted to be in movies, but working in the theatre was about as close as he would come.
title: The Popcorn Kid

overview: Corruption and scandal surround the dealings of a wildly charismatic and ethically challenged mayor of Providence, R.I.
title: Waterfront

overview: Award-winning actor Jesse Tyler Ferguson, Black-ish star Yara Shahidi, actor and comedian June Diane Raphael, and Broadway sensation Andrew Rannells tackle three challenging bakes.
title: The Great American Baking Show Celebrity Summer

overview: One minute he's elbow-deep in a pregnant cow; the next, he's wading through designer pet collars and expensive kibble. That's life for cranky vet Antón!
title: Animal

overview: Everything that lives moves. Even if we don't see it or don't understand how this movement occurs. However, different living organisms move in completely different, sometimes paradoxical ways. What influences the choice of a movement model? These include environmental conditions, the specifics of interaction with neighbors on the planet, the needs for nutrition and reproduction, and many other factors. The goal of the project is to show the different possibilities of movement in nature using various organs of locomotion in any natural environment.
title: Принцип движения

overview: The improvised stand-up show where the audience is the material.
title: Crowd Control

overview: The imperial family and the aristocrats headed by the four major clans co-rule the world. The powerful aristocrats who occupy high positions are oppressive and fail to fulfill their duties, resulting in the people's suffering. Su Leyu is a noble aristocrat, forced to marry her childhood sweetheart, the new emperor Yin Changyan, who is suspected of regicide and seizing the throne. However, Leyu remains sincere with a vision committed to equality. With the new emperor, she promotes women's rights to take examinations and become officials, subverting the power of the aristocrats represented by the Qin family.
title: Luminosity Behind The Palace

overview: On Building Hawaii, Hawaii residents Tyler and Diandra Dickinson are giving it everything they've got to create a successful building company from the ground up. From new construction to renovation, they'll create stunning houses, showing their clients that it's possible to get the home of their dreams while shattering Hawaii's slow "island time" reputation. And with a new baby daughter in tow, they're taking on a big new client: building themselves a brand new home.
title: Building Hawaii

overview: The name is Fury. The fight is personal. With it all on the line, boxer Tommy Fury opens up about his life, legacy and battle to prove his worth - inside the ring and out of it.
title: Tommy: The Good. The Bad. The Fury

overview: Maud Oldcastle - a hilariously brusque, cantankerous, and ruthless older woman… and those are her nice qualities. She's also a killer with a tortured past. Determined to break from a lifetime spent caring for her sister, Maud sets out to claim a long-overdue second act… but a suspicious detective and an unrelenting world built for youth may soon discover just how far she'll go to protect her freedom.
title: Up to No Good

overview: In one of history's most incredible feats, Egyptian architect Imhotep designed and built Djeser's monument: civilisation's very first pyramid. Recognised as a genius, he was also a doctor, astronomer, poet, and philosopher and was celebrated by Egyptians and Greeks alike. But despite his unmistakable stamp on history, his own tomb has never been found. Determined to discover the resting place of the mysterious man who defined Egypt in so many ways, Dr. Zahi Hawass and his international team enter the heart of an ancient stone maze called Gisr el-Mudir, in Saqqara.
title: Imhotep : À la recherche du tombeau perdu
Черкизон. Ад и Рай новой России

overview: They love several people at once, let themselves be tied up or whipped, experience wild fantasies, or dance almost naked for the first time. Nine female scene-goers talk about experiences and feelings in the nightlife and their sexual emancipation. F*ck Berlin is an intimate journey of discovery with a female perspective on the topic of sex.
title: F*ck Berlin

overview: Grace and Leo Harte, both in their 40s run a crumbling hotel on the West Coast of Ireland. Grace feels she is stranded in a passionless marriage. She feels that by upgrading the hotel they might inject new life into their relationship. The hotel, Ostan Harte, has been a fixture on the landscape for many years. Leo sees no need to upgrade the hotel and seems consigned to the state they are in. Where Grace sees stasis, Leo sees stability. At the beginning of the series we see Grace, Leo, and Leo's elderly mother shutting down the hotel for the season as Winter approaches. It's a ritual that appears will go on forever. But we soon learn this is the last year they will ever do this as a series of catastrophic events are set in motion. The catalyst for these events is Danny, a young surfer, who sets up a surfing school on the beach adjacent to the hotel.
title: Grace Harte

overview: Light at the Edge of the World examines this distressing truth, tracking four indigenous cultures. Humanity may be losing half of its intellectual, social and spiritual legacy in a single generation, as the world loses a reported one language about every two weeks. Light at the Edge of the World examines this distressing truth, tracking four indigenous cultures, each uniquely dedicated to the preservation of their customs in the face of modernization: Inuit, Nepali Buddhist, pan-Andean and Polynesian.
title: Light at the Edge of the World

overview: Geneva, April 2015. High-pressure international negotiations begin between the USA and Iran, which is suspected of secretly developing nuclear weapons. Alexandra Weiss, head of the Swiss diplomatic mission, is trying to maintain a fragile balance between the parties maneuvering behind the scenes. The unexpected arrival of her former love, Payam Sanjabi, an Iranian engineer whose life is under threat, will complicate her task dangerously.
title: The Deal
Furen Ta Tao Lu Tai Shen

overview: Elevate your game with this weekly recap of everything from the Madden NFL video game franchise with all the news, ratings releases, tournament updates, and strategies for NFL fans and gamers alike only on Madden NFL Live.
title: Madden NFL Live

overview: The ultimate test of love, trust, and teamwork arrives on UNIMÁSas the hit reality series Are You the One? El Match Perfecto premieres Monday, August 25 at 8 p.m. ET/ 7 p.m. CT. Hosted by acclaimed actor and television personality Vadhir Derbez("Gossip Girl: Acapulco," "Mira Quién Baila," "La Familia P. Luche," "¿Quién es la Máscara?"), the series takes place in the stunning tropical paradise of Trancoso, Brazil, where 24 singles are thrown together with one bold mission: find their perfect match. Through a combination of heart-pounding challenges and emotional revelations, each contestant must identify their one true match from within the group. But there's a twist: the only way to win the $200,000 jackpot is for everyone to succeed. If even one match is wrong, the entire group walks away with nothing. With "everyone wins, or no one does" as its driving mantra, "Are You the One? El Match Perfecto" raises the stakes for love and money like never before.
title: Are You the One? El Match Perfecto

overview: A&E's new docuseries, "Secrets of Celebrity Sex Tapes," offers an in-depth exploration of some of the most infamous celebrity sex tapes of our timeincluding Pamela Anderson and Tommy Lee, Kim Kardashian, Colin Farrell, Farrah Abraham, Mimi Faust, and others. Across eight episodes, hear the story behind each tape and how these iconic moments ignited public obsession, sparked outrage in the cultural zeitgeist and altered the lives of those involved.
title: Secrets of Celebrity Sex Tapes

overview: Anthea Turner presents this Saturday night lottery show, aided and abetted by comedian Patrick Kielty. Celebrity guests and games such as Catapult Cars and Giant Pinball, are a feature of the show which offers members of the public the chance of a cash prize of up to £100,000 in addition to the regular National Lottery draw.
title: The National Lottery Big Ticket

overview: In the high-octane world of the U.S. Navy's toughest fighter pilot school, students face six months of grueling aerial tests, and not all will pass.
title: Top Guns: The Next Generation

overview: Hit Point is an adrenaline-charged blend of high-stakes crime thriller and sizzling romantic drama, following thirtysomething detectives Leo and Bella as their latest case pulls them into a dangerous West London underworld. On the hunt for answers, the lines between their personal and professional lives blur with every twist and betrayal. Packed with razor-sharp humour, and heart-stopping action, Hit Point is a gripping, fast-paced series where loyalty is tested, secrets explode, and love might just be the most dangerous game of all.
title: Hit Point

overview: New Orleans: Soul of a City explores the many ways the city communes with its history – through music, food, sports and tradition – revealing how, 20 years after Katrina, New Orleans is louder and more resilient than ever. The four-part series explores how New Orleans is a city unlike any other and tells its roaring story through music, food, sports and, more importantly, how people rally together when it matters most.
title: New Orleans: Soul Of A City

overview: The Devil has arrived in Moscow and, along with his demons and a large black cat, he carves a trail of chaos and destruction through Soviet society.
title: Mistrz i Małgorzata
